content: Hi, John! I'd like to invite you to dinner this evening.
I have passed my driving test!
Congratulations! I'm really glad to hear that.
Thank you! I have been preparing for it for half a year, you know. And I've made it at last.
So, where shall we have our dinner?
How about the Friendship Hotel? I like the food and service there.
I agree. I'll take you there in my car.
Fine. Let's go at half past six.
